items.original: You will be matched with a certified personal trainer to assess your abilities, determine your action plan and guide your complimentary training session. Your assessment features the InBody 570 Body Composition Analyzer — a detailed snapshot of your body's makeup: body fat, lean muscle, metabolic rate, total body water, and visceral fat — helping you make informed decisions about your fitness and wellness journey.
